t: Robust vacuum cleaner for wet and dry use. Ideal for cleaning up dust, debris, sludge or water. Features power take-off facility, heavy duty stainless steel tank and drain hole on the front of the vacuum for easier emptying. Supplied with 5.5m cable, 2.4m hose and 2 extension tubes giving a total reach of over 9 feet. Easy to store and transport with 2 easy roll castors and 2 sturdy fixed wheels at the rear. On-board tool storage facility. Can be used with or without dust bags.
